## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall and manly lad with curly brown hair and roguish hazel eyes. His mouth is often twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)_

## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever and good-natured young man who maintains a thoughtful perspective on life. Driven by a determination to get the best out of life and put the best into it, he aims to earn his own way through college and elects to get a First Class teacher's license in a single year.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)_

## History

While attending school, Gilbert Blythe sparked a long-standing academic rivalry with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after she rejected his apology for pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots.' Though he later rescued her when her boat sank during a game, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) again refused his offer of friendship. They continued to compete through their time at school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Gilbert earned the graduation medal. After learning he planned to teach locally, Gilbert ultimately gave up his position at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could stay close to home, leading the two to finally reconcile and become close friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), +22 more_

## Quotes

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> “I’m awfully sorry I made fun of your hair, Anne,” he whispered contritely. “Honest I am. Don’t be mad for keeps, now.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)

> "It was my fault Mr. Phillips. I teased her."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began their relationship on rocky ground after he taunted her by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting her to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apology [S1]. They became fierce academic rivals in school [R2], and Gilbert developed an infatuation with her, even rescuing her when her boat sank during a play enactment, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially rejected his offer of friendship [R3, R4, S4]. By the end of their schooling, the former classmates finally reconciled, agreeing to become best friends and assist one another with their studies [R1].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), +18 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert shares a competitive relationship with [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), competing against them as academic rivals in school [R5, S7]. Their rivalry culminates at commencement, where [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) wins the Avery Scholarship and Gilbert wins the school medal [S8].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +5 more_
